verdict.rationale: A UI library's ecosystem, such as its DevTools or docs, could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows React offering an assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The llms.txt file only exposes documentation to external AI tools, and React Compiler is a deterministic build-time optimizer, not an AI assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
